experiment_scope: VOICE-037 emotion transition smoothing for provider-facing voice delivery.

emotion_smoothing_policy.goal: Prevent abrupt emotional jumps in the spoken voice while preserving the guarded response and campaign text.
allowed_changes: increase provider stability inside a bounded range when sharp transition signals are detected
cap provider style/exaggeration when over-emotional cues are detected
record detected and smoothed transition evidence
forbidden_changes: changing protected campaign questions, disclosures, handoff, hangup, or do-not-call text

runtime_cases.case_title: English freeform delivery smooths sharp confidence-to-low pitch transitions
runtime_cases.candidate_response: I will keep this simple. You are right to ask. It is only useful if there is a practical next step.

runtime_cases.case_title: German freeform delivery keeps VOICE-036 relaxation and smooths emotional jumps
runtime_cases.transcript: Das klingt zu teuer und ich weiss nicht, ob sich der Aufwand lohnt.

runtime_cases.case_title: Protected do-not-call text receives no emotion smoothing
runtime_cases.transcript: Rufen Sie mich bitte nicht mehr an.
